text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Summer camp begins, and Gold Ship is hyped to the max for this big adventure—complete with sleepovers and hijinks!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But even the mighty must fall… She exhausts herself and falls asleep en route. The beach is right there! Get up, Gold Ship!
